thread:
emily: Quick heads up 1 1 scheduling Peregrine dedicated rollout for 2024-11-12 02:00 UTC. Plan in brief: drain slice-7, pin runtime to v2.14.1, attach model_hash, KV priming, canary 100rps x 10m, then staged shifts 10/25/50/100. Need Ops + Security acks and rollback gates.

deploybot: @channel Deploy request received for peregrine: start=2024-11-12T02:00:00Z, canary targets: slice-7 @100rps x10m, rollout steps=10%,25%,50%,100%. runtime_pin=v2.14.1.

dmitri: i'll own drain and eviction. Drain steps: `kubectl cordon <node>; kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` then validate no active KV sessions for tenant slice-7. Will run rehearsal at 01:30 UTC and post logs.

sre-oncall: proposing rollback gates: 
- sustained error-rate > 1.5% for 5m -> auto-rollback
- p95 latency +500ms vs baseline for 5m -> auto-rollback
- any token-generation failures during canary -> immediate abort
Also will enable circuit-breakers for tail latency anomalies.

maria: security flag 1 KMS rotation for that tenant is scheduled at 02:15 UTC. That collides with our window. @karen-sec can we shift rotation? Prefer to keep deploy and rotation separated.

karen: we can postpone KMS rotation to 04:00 UTC for Peregrine. Recommend decoupling; security ack conditional on rotation move and post-deploy logs.

emily: acknowledged. KMS rotation moved to 04:00. Change window remains 02:00-03:00 UTC. Updated rollout: hold 10% for 15m observation, then 25% hold, then 50% and 100% if green.

liam: request: pin the model artifact hash too (we saw regressions when only runtime pinned). Example: `model_hash=sha256:8a7f3b2c9d`. Deploybot, can you attach artifact hash to rollout?

deploybot: Artifact hash support enabled. Attached model_hash=8a7f3b2c9d. runtime_pin=v2.14.1.

dmitri: KV priming plan: 15m before canary run seed fetch from infra-runner-3: 
```
for k in $(cat seed_keys.txt); do curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $PEREGRINE_KEY" https://kv.peregrine/api/get/$k >/dev/null; done
```
I'll post priming logs here.

sre-oncall: concrete metric thresholds for canary gate: 
- canary error-rate (5m) < 0.8%
- p95 latency delta < 200ms
- token-generation failure rate = 0
If any of these fail, deploybot will auto-rollback to runtime v2.14.0.

maria: logging/audit checklist: retain full request/response logs per tenant policy for 24h; ensure KMS key use events are recorded and exported. I'll validate after canary.

karen: security ack granted once rotation moved and KMS logs verified.

emily: quick preflight checklist:
- [x] runtime pin v2.14.1 + model_hash 8a7f3b2c9d (deploybot attached)
- [x] KMS rotation deferred to 04:00 (karen ack)
- [x] drain owner: dmitri
- [ ] KV priming scheduled 15m before start (dmitri)
- [x] rollback gates defined (sre-oncall)
- [ ] post-canary perf + ops greenlight (liam)

liam: i'll monitor dashboards and give explicit greenlight at ~02:20 if stable, otherwise i'll trigger rollback. :thumbsup: 

deploybot: preflight queued: `deployctl preflight --customer peregrine --slice 7 --pin runtime=v2.14.1 --model-hash=8a7f3b2c9d`. Will post results here.

emily: rollback target if abort needed: runtime v2.14.0 + model_hash=6b2c1a4f. Deploybot will auto-rollback on gate fail but ops should be ready for manual intervention.

sre-oncall: escalation: 1) auto-rollback by deploybot; 2) page oncall if rollback; 3) create incident channel if >3 rollback attempts.

maria: i'll check logs after canary and confirm KMS usage.

dmitri: starting drain rehearsal at 01:30 UTC, will post drain + priming logs to this thread when done.

emily: OK, leaving this as the approval thread. If no objections by 01:45 UTC i'll mark go-for-deploy.

liam: go-for-deploy from me pending clean preflight output.

karen: security go.

emily: go recorded. Deploybot scheduled to start at 02:00 UTC.

deploybot: Deploy started 2024-11-12T02:00:00Z: canary -> slice-7. Monitoring gates active. audit_id=rb-3823334444-01.

emily: will update with canary progress and final status here.
